info.title: Atlas local API
info.description: Development contract revision 2. Canonical mutation snapshots are read before transaction commit; later reads can advance. Creation replay returns the original creation receipt, not current resource state. Empty strings clear optional string fields; nulls and unknown/duplicate fields are rejected. JSON object bodies are limited to 65536 bytes. Intended for local single-user use.

200.description: Committed state (original creation receipt when replayed)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Scoped to this creation endpoint. Same parsed input replays original committed creation response; different input conflicts. No automatic expiry.

patch.summary: Link or unlink an active reminder directly to an open task

post.summary: Acknowledge a repeating reminder occurrence and queue the next future repeat

200.description: Committed state; retrying an acknowledged occurrence returns current state without advancing

get.summary: List all notes, most recently updated first

post.summary: Create note with optional task and reminder links

200.description: Original creation state replayed from receipt

delete.summary: Delete note and its links; retain activity and receipts

put.summary: Attach existing task or reminder; duplicate link is a no-op

delete.summary: Remove note link; missing link is a no-op

get.description: Literal case-insensitive text search in canonical records, newest update first. Task status: open/completed; reminder status: scheduled/due/dismissed/completed; notes require empty status. Unknown, duplicate, or malformed parameters return invalid_search. Pages may shift between requests when records change.

post.description: Validate explicit capture fields: default task, standalone reminder, or standalone note. Optional note_body links to all new action records. Preview never saves. Confirm unchanged preview.input with a required Idempotency-Key. preview_id identifies normalized content, not authorization. Capture returns TaskAction shape: task may be null, task_id empty, arrays contain captured records.

409.description: Changed/missing preview or conflicting retry key

503.description: Interrupted request or busy storage; retry unchanged

post.description: Validate explicit capture fields: default task, standalone reminder, or standalone note. Optional note_body links to all new action records. Preview never saves. Confirm unchanged preview.input with a required Idempotency-Key. preview_id identifies normalized content, not authorization. Capture returns TaskAction shape: task may be null, task_id empty, arrays contain captured records. A fresh dependency commit rechecks referenced task version and open status; capture_context_changed requires preview again. Receipt replay precedes context checks.

409.description: Changed/missing preview or conflicting retry key

503.description: Interrupted request or busy storage; retry unchanged

post.description: Local English rule interpreter. Uses server reference time; never persists. Ready results include a validated capture proposal; unresolved wording returns questions and null proposal. Clients must display the proposal and obtain confirmation before commit. One task or standalone reminder or standalone note, with optional linked note and task reminder. Explicit before/ahead-of references resolve open task titles; ambiguous matches require selection. Context is visible user input. Ordering does not infer a delivery time.

400.description: invalid_interpretation or strict JSON validation error

get.description: All dependency edges with canonical existence, status, and satisfaction. Deleted endpoints retain title snapshots.

put.description: Idempotently attach prerequisite ordering; cycles and completed targets are rejected.

delete.description: Idempotently remove ordering. Returns source state, or target state when source was deleted.

repeat_anchor.description: Original UTC instant defining the local repeat clock. Empty for one-time reminders.

occurrence_id.description: Current queued or delivered occurrence ID; use in acknowledgement URL.

repeat.description: Daily or weekly in the supplied IANA timezone.

target_title.description: Current target title, or the snapshot captured when linked if deleted.

body.description: Non-whitespace plain text; preserved as supplied.
Non-whitespace plain text; preserved as supplied.

task_id.description: Existing open task ID, or empty to detach. Completed reminders cannot change links.

before_task_id.description: Optional existing open task that this new task must precede.

before_task_version.description: Snapshot fingerprint supplied by preview; return unchanged on commit.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for calendar and clock interpretation

context_task_id.description: Optional explicit context selection, used only for a matching before/ahead-of reference.

draft.description: Partial capture fields; not valid for commit until revalidated. May lack required times or title.
